title: MAXSUN MS-Terminator B760M GKD5 ICE DDR5 LGA1700 Motherboard

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
MAXSUN MS-Terminator B760M GKD5 ICE DDR5 Motherboard – LGA1700, Intel 12th/13th Gen, Micro ATX

The MAXSUN B760M GKD5 ICE is a stylish Micro ATX motherboard with DDR5 memory support, LGA1700 socket, and Intel 12th/13th Gen CPU compatibility. Featuring Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5G LAN, triple M.2 slots, and PCIe 5.0, it delivers powerful performance for gaming and high-end PC builds.

Key Features:

  • Chipset: Intel B760
  • Socket: LGA1700 – Compatible with Intel 12th & 13th Gen Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors
  • Form Factor: Micro ATX (245mm x 245mm)
  • Memory Support: 2 x DDR5 DIMM slotsSupports up to 96GB memory capacity
  • Memory speeds: 4800 MHz to 8600+ MHz (OC) Intel XMP 3.0 support
  • Expansion Slots:
  • 1 x PCIe 5.0 x16 slot
  • 1 x PCIe 3.0 x4 slot
  • 1 x PCIe 3.0 x1 slot
  • Storage:
  • 3 x M.2 slots (Key-M, PCIe 4.0 x4 mode)
  • 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports
  • Graphics Outputs:
  • 1 x DisplayPort 1.4 (up to 7680x4320@30Hz)
  • 1 x HDMI 2.0 (up to 4096x2160@60Hz)
  • Networking: 2.5G LAN (Realtek RTL8125BG)
  • Intel Wi-Fi 6E (AX211) & Bluetooth 5.3
  • Audio: Realtek ALC897, 5.1-Channel High Definition Audio
  • USB Ports:
  • Front: 1 x USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C, 2 x USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A, 6 x USB 2.0
  • Rear: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A, 6 x USB 2.0
  • Internal I/O:
  • 1 x 24-pin ATX power connector
  • 1 x 8+4-pin CPU power connectors
  • 3 x M.2 slots (Key-M)
  • 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports
  • 2 x 5V 3-pin ARGB headers
  • 1 x 12V 4-pin RGB header
  • 1 x Clear CMOS jumper
  • 1 x TPM 2.0 header
  • Operating System Support: Windows 10/11 64-bit
